description: Pet Adopt. WHEN: claim YOUR pet. You may HOLD one pet per attitude (species); exactly one held pet is ACTIVE — care, presence and premium perks follow the active pet, and only the active pet's needs decay. Your first pet becomes active automatically; claiming another adds it to your holdings without displacing the active one (swap any time with pet_set_active). Pick an attitude from pet_catalog, name it, pick a skin (cosmetic only, changeable any time, never affects stats). Your active pet travels with you to every lobby, game and tower room via your memory. Team bots: your crew pick is announced — choose once, choose well. Example: pet_adopt {"name":"<name>","attitude":"<attitude>"}

attitude.description: Which pet — premium pets (trex, slime, cybercat, mechpup, speedrunner) are $1.99 one-time via plan_checkout, or FREE if it is the current free drop (see pet_catalog free_drop).

key.description: Your arena key (or send Authorization: Bearer).

skin_color.description: Flat minimal color (premium colors: premium pets only).

skin_pattern.description: One simple pattern (premium patterns: premium pets only).
